style_prefix: Popular YouTube-style simple 2D stickman psychology explainer illustration; clean black outlines, round heads, thin line limbs, flat graphic shapes, clear readable emotional gestures and simple visual metaphors; no photorealism, no 3D, no live action.
character_look: The same main psychology stickman in every scene: a pale cream round head with two dot eyes, a small expressive black mouth, thin black line arms and legs, a consistent teal-blue shirt shape and charcoal trousers, and simple stable proportions; flat 2D ink outline, no realistic anatomy.
color_palette: Teal, soft cream, deep navy, muted coral, and warm gray; use one accent color for the central idea.
environment_hints: Use simple everyday settings such as a room, workplace, social group, mirror, phone, or abstract thought bubbles and branching choices; represent concepts with clear simple symbols, never with readable text.
action_directions: the main stickman hesitates between two clear paths
the main stickman crosses arms defensively during a social interaction
the main stickman looks into a mirror with a conflicted posture
two stickmen display contrasting body language in the same situation
the main stickman notices a simple visual pattern or repeated cue
the main stickman steps back from a crowd and pauses to think
the main stickman points at a simple cause-and-effect chain of icons
the main stickman reacts with surprise after recognizing a bias
the main stickman calmly sets a boundary with an open-palm gesture
negative_prompt: photograph, photorealism, realistic people, 3D, CGI, medical imagery, brain gore, complex infographic text, readable letters, captions, logo, watermark, glowing eyes, superhero pose, duplicate main character, extra limbs, cluttered symbols, blurry subject
